events.verdict: Boucher (TOR) cleanly deflects the ball from Mobley's (CLE) pass prior to any incidental arm contact occurring.
Boucher (TOR) moves alongside Garland's (CLE) path and legally defends the driving shot attempt. Any body contact that occurs between the two after release is incidental.
Allen (CLE) and Poeltl (TOR) briefly tangle arms before disengaging and the contact during the rebound is marginal.
Allen (CLE) cleanly deflects the loose ball away from Boucher (TOR).
Allen (CLE) remains inbounds while making contact with the loose ball.
LeVert (CLE) is deemed to have possession of the ball prior to the shot clock expiring for Toronto.
Poeltl (TOR) moves laterally into Strus' (CLE) path and initiates body contact that affects his SQBR.
Quickley (TOR) commits a take foul on Garland (CLE).
Poeltl (TOR) attempts to tie the ball up in Allen's (CLE) hands but reaches over Alllen's left shoulder, committing more than marginal contact.
